thread:
Aisha: hey team — need to swap primary for 2026-03-18 22:00Z -> 2026-03-19 06:00Z. flight delayed, i won't be online for the first part. i can be secondary after ~03:30Z if needed.

Tom: what time is your ETA now? can you still do any overlap? :airplane:

Aisha: ETA pushed to ~03:30Z. i can't guarantee being primary from 22:00-03:30. need someone to take full primary for that window, or shadow until i actually land. no active incidents atm.

Riley: i can take primary for the full window. quick check — anything customer-facing still flapping?

Aisha: nothing major. yesterday's embed surge calmed down but please keep an eye on the latency p95 panel. also please pause any canary/model rollouts during the window. runbook: https://redwood.runbooks/oncall/primary-handoff

incident-bot: Incident Bot: Pager rotation conflict detected for 2026-03-18 22:00Z. Current primary: Aisha. Suggested swap: Riley -> primary. To accept, reply "swap accept". To decline, reply "swap decline".

Riley: swap accept — i'll be primary 22:00-06:00 UTC. i'll be watching alerts and presence. please add any special operational notes here.

Tom: adding the canary pause snippet — put this in pre-handoff steps:

```
# pause canary rollouts (internal ops)
curl -X POST https://internal-api.redwood/ops/canary/pause -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
```

Also dashboard: https://observe.redwood/d/latency (watch p95 and error-rate)

Sam: i'll be secondary/standby 22:00-02:00 UTC then available to shadow after 02:00. if P1 occurs, page both Riley and Sam.

Aisha: one more ops knob — fallback model is now rdx-v2-quant. if you see a spike in 5xx, flip fallback: 

```
# switch fallback model
kubectl -n inference set env service/router FALLBACK_MODEL=rdx-v2-quant
```

Riley: noted, added snippet to my local runbook copy and the handoff notes. i've also updated the rotation CSV (/schedules/oncall.csv).

deploy-bot: Deploy Bot: scheduled rollouts are paused while handoff is unresolved. To resume rollouts after handoff, run `ops resume-rollouts`.

Tom: Riley — can you confirm you'll set PD status to Primary for the window (so escalation pages go to you)?

Riley: done — updated PagerDuty primary for 2026-03-18 22:00Z -> 2026-03-19 06:00Z. left a short note about embed-threshold context.

Aisha: checklist i'm leaving before i go:
- confirm PD primary set
- pause canary rollouts (see curl snippet)
- verify fallback env var set to rdx-v2-quant
- copy alert thresholds and dashboard links into handoff note
- slack contact for travel ETA (i'll post if further delayed)

Sam: acknowledged. i'll keep a close watch 22:00-02:00 and be ready to escalate. :phone:

Riley: i'll run through the pre-shift checklist 30m before 22:00 and post final ack.

Aisha: thank you all — really appreciate the cover. i'll post again if ETA changes. :bow:

Tom: quick ops note for whoever is primary: watch for latency > 350ms p95 or error-rate > 0.8% sustained over 5m. treat that as a high-priority triage path.

Riley: logged those thresholds into the primary handoff note.

incident-bot: Incident Bot: handoff confirmed. New primary: Riley. Secondary: Sam. Handoff window: 2026-03-18T22:00Z - 2026-03-19T06:00Z.

Sam: thanks — on standby. good luck.

Aisha: thanks team, really appreciate it.
